;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Anchorage earthquake]]
**A [[Moment magnitude scale|magnitude 7.0]] earthquake hits Alaska, with the epicenter in [[Anchorage, Alaska|Anchorage]]. Severe damage is reported. [https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us1000hyfh/executive (USGS)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/alaska-earthquake-today-anchorage-tsunami-alert-issued-live-updates/ (CBS News)]
*[[Tornadoes of 2018]]
**A severe storm system brings tornado watches and warnings throughout the U.S. states of [[Oklahoma]], [[Texas]], [[Arkansas]], and [[Missouri]]. A "large and dangerous" tornado is confirmed near [[Gore, Oklahoma]]. Several other tornadoes are seen by storm chasers. [https://www.4029tv.com/article/tracking-severe-storms-for-friday-night/25346439 (4029 News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Marriott International]] discloses that its [[Starwood Hotels and Resorts|Starwood Hotel]] brand had been subject to a data breach. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/11/30/tech/marriott-breach-what-to-do/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**A [[Rail transport in South Korea|South Korean train]] arrives towards [[Panmun Station]] and crosses the [[Korean Demilitarized Zone|DMZ]] border for the first time since 2008, when a [[South Korea|South Korean]] cargo train operated five times a week. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/south-korea-sends-a-train-into-north-for-the-first-time-in-a-decade/2018/11/30/e4942e66-f459-11e8-9240-e8028a62c722_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46395408 (BBC)] [https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/2175776/south-korean-trains-venture-over-border-first-time-decade-fix (''South China Morning Post'')]
*[[Russia–Ukraine relations]], [[Martial law in Ukraine]]
**[[Ukraine]] bans [[Russians|Russia]]n men aged between 16 and 60 from entering the country following the imposition of [[Martial law in Ukraine|martial law]]. President [[Petro Poroshenko]] says the ban is to prevent the formation of "private armies" in Ukraine. Russia says it does not plan to retaliate. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-46397644 (BBC)]
*[[2018 G20 Buenos Aires summit]]
**The [[United States]], [[Canada]] and [[Mexico]] sign the [[United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement]] in [[Buenos Aires]], replacing the [[North American Free Trade Agreement]]. [https://www.ttnews.com/articles/nafta-replacement-usmca-signed-awaits-ratification-congress (TTNews)] [https://www.npr.org/2018/11/30/672150010/usmca-trump-signs-new-trade-agreement-with-mexico-and-canada (NPR)]

;Law and crime
*[[Nigeria]]n police killed 104 cattle thieves in operations in the north-western state of Zamfara. *The [[Supreme Court of Canada]] says that [[Vice Media]] reporter Ben Makuch must give the [[Royal Canadian Mounted Police]] material he gathered for stories about an accused [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] terrorist. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/supreme-court-vice-ben-makush-decision-1.4926102 (CBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**[[Sam Gyimah]] resigns as [[United Kingdom|British]] [[Minister of State]] for the [[Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy]] in protest to [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]]'s [[Brexit]] withdrawal deal. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2018/nov/30/sam-gyimah-resigns-over-theresa-mays-brexit-deal (''The Guardian'')]
* Former U.S. President [[George H. W. Bush]] dies of [[Parkinsonism]] at the age of 94, at about 10:10 p.m. [[Central Standard Time|CST]].
